# GOTCHA

> AI-powered customer communication platform

## What is GOTCHA?

GOTCHA is a multi-channel customer communication platform that unifies WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, and email into a single AI-powered inbox. It helps customer support teams respond faster, route smarter, and deliver better experiences.

## Key Features

- **AI Co-Pilot**: Real-time reply suggestions, conversation summaries, and knowledge-powered answers for support agents.
- **Unified Multi-Channel Inbox**: WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, and email in one place.
- **Smart Routing**: Auto-assign conversations to the right department and agent with SLA tracking.
- **Knowledge Base**: Upload documents or connect Confluence/Google Drive - the AI learns your business.
- **Visual Bot Builder**: Drag-and-drop conversation flow builder with FAQ automation and agent handover.
- **Real-Time Analytics**: Monitor response times, agent workload, conversation volume, and SLA compliance.
- **Department Management**: Organize teams with role-based access, queue modes, and per-department AI configuration.
- **Business Hours & SLA**: Set schedules, auto-responses, idle reminders, and auto-close rules.

## Supported Channels

- WhatsApp Business (via Embedded Signup)
- Facebook Messenger
- Instagram DMs
- Email

## Use Cases

- Customer support teams managing high-volume messaging
- Sales teams qualifying leads across messaging platforms
- Businesses automating FAQ responses with AI chatbots
- Organizations needing SLA-tracked, department-routed communication
